record.body:
## Description

Store discovery handles linked git worktrees; session hooks do not clobber existing views when a stale plugin reads zero records.

## Approach

Fix root/store resolution for worktrees (common git dir / binding). In session_hooks, if record read count is 0 and views already exist, skip overwrite or warn without clobber. Tests for worktree path and hook guard.

payload.title: Worktree-aware discovery and stale-hook view guard
